description: Redeem a paid single-chart purchase (from create_checkout with kind 'single_chart') and receive the clean, full-resolution PNG. Call this after the user confirms payment. Returns payment_pending while the checkout is unpaid — wait for the user, do not poll in a loop. By default the image is only delivered inline and never stored; pass returnUrl:true if the user needs a downloadable file — the response then also includes chartUrl, a direct link to the PNG valid for 24 hours — surface it to the user.

returnUrl.description: Set true to also get chartUrl, a 24h download link to the purchased PNG. This stores a copy on CleanChart's servers for 24 hours — leave unset for inline-only delivery.

name: claim_chart
title: Claim purchased chart
